On November 16, 2026, the Company announced topline data for its Phase 3 PIVOT-006 registrational trial evaluating adjuvant intravesical cretostimogene in patients with intermediate-risk and high-grade Ta ≤3 cm non-muscle invasive bladder cancer (“ NMIBC ”) following complete tumor resection.
The Company also plans to submit a BLA for the use of cretostimogene in intermediate-risk and high-grade Ta NMIBC in the second quarter of 2027.
